row.evidence: Temporal's pricing docs say "SCIM is included in the Enterprise or Mission Critical support plans. SCIM is available as an add-on for the Developer or Business plan (+$500/month)."
row.notes: Still gated, but the shape changed since June. Temporal replaced the Essentials plan with a pay-as-you-go plan (docs call it Developer): $0 base, $50 per million actions, support at 10% of usage. SCIM is now a +$500/month add-on on Developer or Business, where June had it only on Business ($500/mo) plus the add-on. It is included on Enterprise and Mission Critical, which are annual and Contact Sales. The marketing pricing.md lists the add-on only under Business, while the docs pricing page also offers it on Developer (see conflicts). SAML SSO is included on all plans and must be set up before SCIM. Support enables SCIM through a ticket, and the IdP admin then gets a configuration link by email. Pricing is usage-based, so the per-user fields are null.

roles.how: SCIM groups map to Temporal Cloud account roles and Namespace permissions; roles are assigned to synced groups with tcld or the UI.

limitations.text: SCIM must be enabled by Temporal Support through a support ticket after SAML is configured.
Okta user and group changes are applied within 10 minutes, not in real time.
Users can still be added and removed outside SCIM in the UI until user lifecycle management is disabled.

auth.notes: Bearer API key owned by a user or service account; permissions come from account roles (deleting users needs Account Owner or Global Admin).

rate_limits.text: 160 requests per second per account across all Control Plane clients; 40 RPS per user; 80 RPS per service account; 10 concurrent asynchronous mutating operations.

conflicts.text: The marketing pricing.md lists 'SCIM available as add-on (+$500/mo)' only under Business, while the docs pricing page says SCIM is an add-on for the Developer or Business plan; the docs page is used.

open_questions: No public SCIM endpoint reference: base URL, auth method, token expiry, supported attributes, filtering and pagination are undocumented.
Whether SCIM deprovisioning deletes or suspends the user, and whether sessions are revoked, beyond 'User deletion / offboarding', is not stated.
Whether SCIM pushes attribute updates (PUT/PATCH) is not stated.
Okta OIN, Entra gallery and JumpCloud catalogue entries for Temporal Cloud could not be confirmed (404/403), and the web search budget was exhausted.
Whether the emailed configuration link means a third-party SCIM broker is not stated.
